# sv-skills (easygl1der/supervisor-skills-plus)

> Yihua Yue's academic research skill library: twelve `sv-*` groups covering project records, reading and study, literature review, idea evaluation, proposals, experiments, drafting and polishing, figures, review, feedback and group-meeting slides, plus `research-core` (shared rules). Installable as Agent Skills under `skills/`. A cited Chinese curriculum lives at `handbook/`, with an English mirror at `handbook-en/`.

Target audience: researchers writing papers (SE/MSR, ML, mathematics, statistics, causal inference, and related venues).

## Install

Clone this repository and follow [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) (agent-sync links or `scripts/install.sh`).

See [README.md](README.md) (Chinese) or [README.en.md](README.en.md) for full details.

## Skills

Twelve groups (ADR 0021). Each `sv-<group>` entry routes to slash-only sub-commands `sv-<group>-<name>`; `research-core` holds the shared rules. Guide: [skills/README.en.md](skills/README.en.md).

- [sv-supervisor](skills/sv-supervisor/SKILL.md): session brief and routing, project start-up, records (STATUS, TODO, ADRs, logs), lessons into research-core.
- [sv-quickread](skills/sv-quickread/SKILL.md): nine-section five-minute card of one paper; optional style card.
- [sv-study](skills/sv-study/SKILL.md): understanding-first study of a concept, paper or chapter with restatement and diagnosis; figures, drills, bridge to the project.
- [sv-idea](skills/sv-idea/SKILL.md): full idea evaluation or the fatal-flaws gate.
- [sv-litreview](skills/sv-litreview/SKILL.md): survey-grade literature review with verified citations, or a map of papers already read.
- [sv-proposal](skills/sv-proposal/SKILL.md): thesis proposals (kaiti), grant applications, research statements.
- [sv-experiment](skills/sv-experiment/SKILL.md): frozen inputs, pre-registered confirmatory analyses with a git audit, runs log, traceable numbers, replication artifact.
- [sv-write](skills/sv-write/SKILL.md): skeleton, Introduction, sections, polish, Chinese-to-English, critique, de-AI by scenario, venue style.
- [sv-figure](skills/sv-figure/SKILL.md): figure design, draw.io reconstruction, code plots, TikZ, HTML, posters, explanatory figures.
- [sv-review](skills/sv-review/SKILL.md): read-only pre-submission audit or a bounded multi-round check.
- [sv-feedback](skills/sv-feedback/SKILL.md): tracked revisions from comments, expert guidance records, rebuttal plans.
- [sv-slides](skills/sv-slides/SKILL.md): Beamer decks for group meetings: weekly report or paper talk.
- [research-core](skills/research-core/SKILL.md): core rules, field and venue profiles, sourced checklists, AI-collaboration rules, project templates.

## Reader curriculum (cited source material)

`handbook/` and `handbook-en/` are included because skills still cite them. They are not this project's brand. Provenance: [handbook/README.md](handbook/README.md), [THIRD_PARTY.md](THIRD_PARTY.md).

- `handbook/01_Preliminary/` — evaluating paper quality from a reviewer's perspective.
- `handbook/02_Idea_Generation/` — idea lifecycle, five-dimension thinking, disruptive innovation.
- `handbook/03_Paper_Writing/` — paper lifecycle, Introduction flowchart, technical and benchmark templates, writing checklist.
- `handbook/04_Scientific_Plotting/` — motivated, overview, experimental figures and a drawing checklist.
- `handbook/05_Vibe_Research/` — AI-assisted research workflow and practitioner notes.
- `handbook/06_Case_Studies/` — Alpha-SQL (ICML 2025), AFlow (ICLR 2025), LEAD (VLDB 2026) Introduction analyses, plus 6.4, an anonymized process case.
